page.overview:
Who is Abraham Cornelius?

As revenge for destroying the Weapon X Project, having him sent to a federal prison, and forcing him to go into hiding, Dr. Cornelius transformed and mutated a paralyzed teenager into a cyborg assassin named Deathstrike to kill Wolverine. Doctor Cornelius pursued Wolverine and Storm in a helicopter but the helicopter was brought down during the pursuit.

Doctor Cornelius was later revealed to have survived his crash, but with heavy injuries and had sent Sabretooth to collect some of Wolverine's DNA in an attempt to create a clone, but was only able to create deformed rejects. To successfully test the DNA, Doctor Cornelius grafted the DNA to himself, horribly mutating his body and driving him insane. Wolverine and his team confronted doctor Cornelius in his secret laboratory where after much effort Wolverine managed to kill Cornelius via decapitation.
